title: One model call
intro: A model call is one request to the API. You send a list of messages and receive one message back.

steps.author: system
steps.label: System
steps.narration: People call this the prompt. It is a list of messages. The first item is the system message: instructions for this call.

steps.author: user
steps.label: User
steps.narration: The second item is the user message, the question you want answered. The list now has two messages.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Assistant
steps.narration: Your program calls OpenAI's Chat Completions API with chat.completions.create, passing the message list and the model gpt-4.1-mini. The API returns one response object that contains an assistant message. print outputs that message's text. The program does not call the model again.
